description: Per-node IPsec tunnel to the NAS: tunnel state, traffic, certificate expiry. Metrics come from the ipsec-cert-sync DaemonSet in kcs-ipsec.

panels.title: Tunnels up
panels.description: Workers that have an established IPsec tunnel to the NAS.

panels.title: Tunnels down
panels.description: Workers that report no tunnel. Anything above 0 needs attention.

panels.title: Workers reporting
panels.description: Workers whose ipsec-cert-sync pod is being scraped.

panels.title: Soonest certificate expiry
panels.description: Days until the first node certificate expires. cert-manager renews 30 days before expiry.

panels.title: Tunnel state per node
panels.description: UP when the node has an established tunnel to the NAS.

panels.title: Certificate days left per node
panels.description: From the certificate in each node's NSS database, which is what libreswan actually uses.

panels.title: Traffic through the tunnel
panels.description: Bytes per second sent to and received from the NAS through IPsec. NFS traffic shows up here.

panels.title: Tunnel age per node
panels.description: Time since the current tunnel was established. A small value on one node means it was re-established recently.

panels.title: Metrics age per node
panels.description: Time since the collector last ran. More than 5 minutes means the collector container stopped.

panels.title: libreswan version per node
panels.description: The libreswan version installed on each node.

panels.title: Certificate source per node
panels.description: Which option put the certificate on each node: B (cert-sync), C (wildcard MachineConfig) or A (shared MachineConfig). A node with none of their markers shows nothing.

panels.title: Nodes reported twice
panels.description: Nodes with more than one ipsec-cert-sync pod reporting (alert IpsecNasDuplicateNode). Must be 0.

panels.title: Pods reporting the wrong node
panels.description: Pods whose node label differs from the node Kubernetes placed them on (alert IpsecNasNodeLabelMismatch). Must be 0.

panels.title: Kernel IPsec errors, last hour
panels.description: Packets the kernel IPsec code dropped in the last hour, over every selected node: the sum of the counters in /proc/net/xfrm_stat, each of which counts drops for one reason.

panels.title: Per node
panels.description: One row per node. Why a tunnel is down: no certificate, no connection (NNCP), no IKE SA, or libreswan not answering. A cell showing – or nothing means unknown: no series (for example the IKE SA when libreswan does not answer). NFS requests/s comes from the platform's node-exporter. The reporting pod of each node, and the NAS identity of each node whose tunnel is up, are in the table below.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_nfs_requests_total{instance=~"$node"}[5m]), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")) and on (node) max by (node) (ipsec_nas_collect_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: NAS identity per node
panels.description: The ipsec-cert-sync pod that reports each node, and the identity the NAS presented, from its certificate. A node with no tunnel has no NAS identity. A node in two rows is reported by two pods.

targets.expr: max by (node, pod, peer_id) (ipsec_nas_tunnel_info{node=~"$node"}) or on (node, pod) max by (node, pod) (ipsec_nas_collect_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Tunnel re-establishments in the last hour
panels.description: How often each node's tunnel was set up again. Above 3 fires IpsecNasTunnelFlapping: a tunnel that keeps restarting looks up on the other panels.

panels.title: Kernel IPsec errors per node
panels.description: Rate of the error counters in /proc/net/xfrm_stat, by counter. Lines appear only for counters that moved.

panels.title: Namespaces using the NAS
panels.description: Namespaces with at least one claim whose volume the NFS CSI driver (nfs.csi.k8s.io) made. The NAS IP of each is in the table below.

targets.expr: count(count by (namespace) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)")))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Claims on the NAS
panels.description: Claims whose volume the NFS CSI driver made, in all namespaces.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Claims not Bound
panels.description: Claims of a StorageClass of the NFS CSI driver that are not Bound (Pending: the driver could not create the directory, or cannot reach the NAS). Must be 0.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{phase!="Bound"} == 1) and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (storageclass) group_left () max by (storageclass) (kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: NAS pods without a working tunnel
panels.description: Pods that mount a NAS claim on a node whose tunnel is down, or whose node has no collector reporting it. Their NFS cannot reach an IPsec-only NAS. Must be 0.

targets.expr: count(((0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) + on (node) group_left () max by (node) (ipsec_nas_tunnel_up)) or (0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) - 1)) < 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Claims on the NAS
panels.description: Each claim whose volume the NFS CSI driver made: where it lives on the NAS (taken from the volume's handle) and what deleting the claim does to the volume (reclaim policy; what happens to the data is the class's onDelete).

targets.expr: (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (phase) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, phase) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase == 1)

panels.title: Pods using NAS claims, and their node's tunnel
panels.description: Each pod that mounts a NAS claim, the node it runs on, and that node's IPsec tunnel: UP, DOWN, or NO COLLECTOR (no pod of the collector reports the node, so its tunnel is not watched). The node filter applies here.

targets.expr: (0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) + on (node) group_left () max by (node) (ipsec_nas_tunnel_up)) or (0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) - 1)

title: IPsec to the NAS
